app.notes:
Downloading the sample SoundFonts switches MIDI songs from the built-in sound to one of them, picked at random; a SoundFont you already use stays
TV remotes reach the songs in the stage search: it opens on the first song, and Down from the search box goes to the songs
Number buttons in the stage search type into it and keep the highlight on the songs
The Reserve List on the stage opens on the first reserved song
